summary: Pasquotank County NC tower site; a 120-ft Knightdale tower was moved here after 1972, but sources disagree on the dates and on which tower stands here.

facts.status_note: Two histories say a 120-ft tower was moved to South Mills; one undated Facebook post says a tower there stands. No source confirms what is on the site now.

access.note: Forest Lookouts says the tower is on state-owned land; no source read gives visiting rules.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Facebook post gives 1972 and 120 ft. Legeros and Forest Lookouts date the 120-ft Knightdale tower's erection to 1938; 1972 is when it was removed. The story follows the two histories.

unresolved_conflicts.field: identity of the tower on the site
unresolved_conflicts.explanation: Forest Lookouts describes a 99-ft 9-in tower erected in 1944 at South Mills. Legeros says a 120-ft tower was moved to South Mills. No source says whether these are the same structure or which one stands on the site now.

notes_for_editor: Four sources plus one undated Facebook post. The list entry gives coordinates only. Forest Lookouts (1944 tower, 2018 auction, state land) and Legeros (Knightdale 120-ft tower moved to South Mills after 1972) describe possibly different towers; the record does not resolve which stands on the site. The Facebook post's 120 ft matches the Knightdale height but its 1972 date is the removal year. The Legeros height is printed with a damaged character; the story says 120-foot per Forest Lookouts. No source describes the site now or public access.
